name: che-apple-notes-mcp
description: SQLite fast read + AppleScript safe write for macOS Notes.app
long_description: MCP server providing 18 tools for macOS Apple Notes.app. Dual-track architecture: direct NoteStore.sqlite reads (<10 ms for 1000+ notes) and AppleScript writes that preserve CloudKit sync. Supports folders CRUD, notes CRUD with dual-track body (plaintext or HTML input, both returned on read), keyword search, batch operations, and process-local undo/redo. Falls back to AppleScript for reads when Full Disk Access is not granted. Requires macOS 13 or later.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all note folders across all accounts (iCloud / On My Mac)

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in a specific account

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes with filters (folder, account, pinned, locked, date range) and optional body inclusion

tools.name: list_notes_quick
tools.description: Preset ranges: recent, today, this_week, pinned

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Fetch a single note with full body (text + HTML) and metadata

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note; body_text XOR body_html; optional folder + account

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update a note's title and/or body by id

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move a note to a different folder

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: SQL LIKE keyword search over title + snippet; any or all match mode

tools.name: create_notes_batch
tools.description: Create multiple notes in one AppleScript dispatch

tools.name: move_notes_batch
tools.description: Move multiple notes to the same destination folder

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Revert the most recent write operation (process-local stack)
